purpose: Additional diagnostics of already frozen boundary102 versus same-exclusion v4; no fitting, selection, retuning, promotion gate or final reserve access

idsse_J03WMX.description: Original DFL development game, CC BY 4.0, IDSSE / Sportec / DFL.
idsse_J03WMX.clock_description: Within each GameSection, raw N advances at 25 Hz. Reader concatenates firstHalf, 250 empty grid rows, secondHalf. Native timestamps use this concatenated clock, not wall time; source_frame retains raw N.

skillcorner_1925299.description: Prior SkillCorner development game in expanded_team_training.json, MIT; credit SkillCorner.
skillcorner_1925299.clock_description: Native frame f has time f/10 seconds, matching the existing reader. match_periods supplies half-open native frame ranges independently of phases. Canonical period/gt use the reader floor mapping.

hz15_noise0p5.description: 15 Hz requested, 0.5 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

hz10_noise2.description: 10 Hz requested, 2 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

additional_controls.native_observed_only: Same converter with source-native observation_hz, zero coordinate noise and zero burst starts; separates resampling/observed-only representation from perturbation

isolation: All original game copies use the same excluded outer-fold neural models and same fully excluded inherited components. Verify actual train-only normalizers, lineage and asset hashes. No full-fit release models on familiar games.
scoring: Unchanged official spellF1 plus macroF1 and H/A/D F1; preserve every condition and loss. Aggregate per-game paired candidate-control gains; no treating copies as independent games. SkillCorner 15Hz capped at10Hz and duplicates explicitly retained as aliases.
scope: Two previously used development games only, not independent external confirmation; synthetic corruption is not real camera/provider variation
storage: Process one condition in memory; persist aggregate scores, hashes and predicted labels only locally. Do not materialize every full tracking NPZ.
